title: DEA-C01 as one pipeline: the decision each stage asks for

steps.title: Getting data in
steps.note: Batch or streaming: S3 with events, DMS, Kinesis or MSK, Firehose, AppFlow

steps.title: Transforming it
steps.note: Glue, EMR, Lambda, Redshift SQL or DataBrew; orchestrate with Step Functions, MWAA or EventBridge

steps.title: Storing it
steps.note: S3 lake in Parquet, compressed and partitioned; Redshift as the warehouse; DynamoDB for key-value

steps.title: Running and fixing it
steps.note: CloudWatch, Glue Data Quality, re-runs; look for small files, skew or a missing partition filter

steps.title: Protecting it
steps.note: SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS, IAM, Lake Formation for columns and rows, Macie, CloudTrail

caption: Read the cards in order: each is one stage of this guide, with the services its questions choose between.
